title: yes do them. goal is parallelize here, also, we should find a way to prevent the merge conflicts, that was the idea of …

items.content: Mouse scroll must not change selection in any panel; only keys do (FEN6)
Channel to-dos panel: show only active tasks with agent info; completed ones in collapsible task history (RUS197)
Empty channel: ASCII-art channel name plus coordinator welcome message (new agent)
Channel History tab (RUS201 never started; needs a cloud-backed agent)
Root-cause and fix: members created without a cloud machine never start; duplicate sessions; lost messages; red error state. Needs a cloud-backed agent (RUS202 never started)
Older cloud machines: redeploy/update, hub checks tools before ship prompt, hub queues their branches (RUS197)
Plan view header: created when, by whom, for which agent, assignee, machine (RUS199)
Harness bugs: no local fallback when cloud hub is down (duplicate sessions); undeliverable agent messages fail loudly (RUS198)
Wheel in pop-up pickers scrolls without moving the highlight (FEN6)
Merge queue leftovers: target branch config, cloud machines pull target, worktree outside .git, Queue tab lists all, late-opened channel, stale plan hint, pub(crate), let _ (RUS199)
Raw git push bypasses queue; per-member worktrees for local members (RUS197, after ship gap)
History lists /plan text typed in a channel (RUS200, after current)
Diagnose why GitHub Actions runs no jobs (EXP71)
Red errors in chat, stall notices, shared Stop-button red (RUS202 follow-up to #74)
PR #74 review fixes (FEN6, taken from RUS202)
Queue tab full history, late-open state, stale hint (RUS200, split from RUS199)
Fewer merge conflicts: changelog fragments, queue auto-resolves trivial conflicts, overlap warnings (RUS204)

summary: RUS202 dropped the duplicate review fixes before building anything, so FEN6 is the only one doing them. RUS202 is free, and its red-error change is on main as #82.
